sv.title: Ledamot miljontankar i Berner Industrier
sv.summary: Investmentbolaget Zubizuri, som kontrolleras av Berner Industriers styrelseledamot Johan Lannebo, har köpt 50.000 aktier i Berner Industrier för cirka 3,5 miljoner kronor.

en.title: Board member buys shares worth millions in Berner Industrier
en.summary: Investment company Zubizuri, controlled by Berner Industrier board member Johan Lannebo, has bought 50,000 shares in Berner Industrier for about SEK 3.5 million.
